{{Short description|Russian mathematician and educator}}
'''Boris A. Kordemsky''' ({{langx|ru|Борис Анастасьевич Кордемский}}; 23 May 1907 &ndash; 29 March 1999) was a Russian [[mathematician]] and [[educator]].  He is best known for his [[popular science]] books and [[mathematical puzzle]]s.  He is the author of over 70 books and popular mathematics articles.

Kordemsky was born in [[Kiknur]], [[Vyatka Governorate]], [[Russian Empire]].  He received his Ph.D. in education in 1956 and taught mathematics at several [[Moscow]] colleges.
